decision_conditions: The proposed first floor extension, by reason of its depth, height and position close to the shared boundary, would be an overbearing and visually intrusive form of development that would have an adverse effect on the amenity of the adjacent occupiers at No.11 Douglas Avenue, contrary to Local Plan Policy 7 and the Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, notification of intended refusal and the reason(s) for it was given to Divi Design (Agent) on 20/04/26.
description: Loft extension & first floor extension, hip to gable end roof extensions, installation of rear dormer and roof lights to front
